title: The Food Tunnel Adventure
intro: This quiz follows Nora and Jayden as they learn how food travels through the digestive system.

questions.prompt: What do teeth and saliva do in the mouth?
choices: Teeth absorb nutrients, and saliva forms waste
Teeth mash food, and saliva softens it and begins breaking it down
Teeth move food to the stomach, and saliva absorbs water
Teeth make vitamins, and saliva carries oxygen
questions.explanation: Teeth mash food, and saliva softens it and begins breaking it down.

questions.prompt: What is the job of the esophagus?
choices: To push food from the mouth to the stomach
questions.explanation: The esophagus pushes food from the mouth to the stomach.

questions.prompt: Where are most nutrients absorbed into the blood?
questions.explanation: Most nutrients are absorbed into the blood in the small intestine.

questions.prompt: Which order correctly shows the path food takes?
choices: Mouth → stomach → esophagus → large intestine → small intestine
Mouth → esophagus → stomach → small intestine → large intestine
Stomach → mouth → esophagus → small intestine → large intestine
Mouth → small intestine → stomach → esophagus → large intestine
questions.explanation: Food travels from the mouth through the esophagus, stomach, small intestine, and large intestine.
